collect_note: Reads the full-proposal deadlines of the current NSF SBIR/STTR solicitation (NSF 26-510) from the NSF solicitation page twice a day and shows the nearest one still ahead. Right now that is Mar 4, 2027.

sample.title: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I, Phase II and Fast-Track (NSF 26-510)

evidence: Channels tried 2026-11-12: Grants.gov search2 (agencies NSF, keyword 'SBIR STTR', oppStatuses forecasted|posted) returned 1 unrelated hit (PD-98-1331) and oppNum 'NSF 26-510' returned 0 hits, so NSF SBIR is not on Grants.gov. seedfund.nsf.gov/solicitations/ is static HTML that links NSF 26-510 and 26-511 but carries no deadlines and its linked solicitation pages sit on another host (nsf.gov), so a list with detail hop cannot read them. The nsf.gov solicitation page is static HTML (30 KB) with 'Full Proposal Deadline(s)': July 27 2026, November 04 2026, March 04 2027, July 07 2027.
edge_risk: A replacement solicitation (new NSF number) would not be seen until this page changes; the deadline_regex is tied to the four listed dates.
